note: EMPTY, AND IT SHOULD STAY EMPTY. This file existed to record build tables with a node touching only one component, or a watched node the table never builds, so that new ones failed the build while a backlog of 55 was worked through. That backlog is closed: every build table in the course now has a netlist a reader can enter into a simulator. Any entry appearing here again is a regression, not debt - fix the table rather than blessing it. Regenerating with --bless after breaking something will silently make it permanent.
